The '''Kumumgah''' were an ancient [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="DOTJFS1" /> They developed spaceflight, drawing the attention of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], who [[Conquest of Tatooine|conquered]], enslaved, and annexed them to their [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars| Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> in [[25,793 BBY]].<ref name="DOTJFS1" />

The Kumumgah eventually [[Bombardment of Tatooine|rebelled]] and were punished by the Rakata, who [[Bombardment of Tatooine|bombed]] the surface of the once-lush world of Tatooine into little more than fused [[Glass/Legends|glass]]. This glass eventually crumbled and became [[Desert/Legends|desert]] sand.<ref name="KOTOR" /> Over time, the Kumumgah would evolve into two species:<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> the Ghorfas, who would become<ref name="LCT">{{StoryCite|story=The Lost City of Tatooine|book=Wikipedia:Dig_(magazine)|bformatted=''Archaeology's Dig'' July 1999}}</ref> the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], and the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].<ref name="GPBTG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' puts forth the hypothesis that perhaps the Kumumgah, and by extension, the Tusken Raiders<ref name="KOTOR" /> and the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]],<ref name="GPBTG" /> are, in fact, [[Human/Legends|Human]], or at least are related to [[Zhell/Legends|them]]. During dialogue with the [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|tribe]]'s [[The Storyteller (Sand People)|storyteller]] in the Sand People's village, if the main character, [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], asks whether the similarities between those who were taken by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] and the Human colonists are physical or societal, [[HK-47]] will remark, "Cautionary: Master, if you mean to suggest that humanity is ancestrally linked to ancient Tatooine, you will strain his belief system to its pitiful [[Meatbag/Legends|meatbag]] maximum."<ref name="KOTOR" />
